title: Booking with no PO number yet, inline size lists, '5th March' date, CIF
subject: Polo booking – MF-PL-77
body:
Hi Karthik,

Following our call, please book the MF-PL-77 piqué polo. Our formal PO number will follow from our buying office next week, but please reserve capacity now.

Price: GBP 7.20 per piece, CIF Felixstowe
Ex-factory: 5th March 2027
Destination: United Kingdom

Deep Teal: S-120 / M-240 / L-240 / XL-120
Oat Marl: S-80 / M-160 / L-160 / XL-80

Total 1,200 pcs.

Best regards,
Priya Lal
Marigold & Finch Ltd
Leeds
